display: Cloudflare key-maker (lets StuntKey make keys for you)
steps: Sign in to Cloudflare if it asks; the token form opens filled in (API Tokens: Edit)
Scroll down, click 'Continue to summary', then 'Create Token'
Click Copy next to the token - you only do this once; after that `stuntkey mint` makes Cloudflare keys for you
unverified: key_url prefill key 'api_tokens' (if the form opens empty, add the permission 'User - API Tokens - Edit' by hand)

least_privilege.summary: This token can only create and delete other API tokens. StuntKey uses it to make narrow keys (for example read-only analytics) and never shows it.

steps: Sign in; this is My Profile > API Tokens
Open the menu (...) next to 'StuntKey key-maker' and choose Delete
